lines.en: label futabanew2:
scene futabanewtwo1
I toss aside a stack of papers that Makoto wanted me to go over after taking one look at them and deciding that I have much better things to do with my time.
lines.zh: 我把 Makoto 要我过目的那摞文件随手推开——只看了一眼，我就断定自己有远比这更值得花时间的事。

lines.en: I can not risk being distracted by clerical work when there are so many girls in my class that could need assistance at any given moment.
lines.zh: 班上有那么多女生随时可能需要帮助，我可不能冒着被文书工作分心的风险。

lines.en: Now, I understand and acknowledge that most of the girls in my class {i}do not{/i} actively seek out my assistance when it comes to personal issues...
lines.zh: 当然，我心里明白也承认，班上大多数女生遇到私人问题时{i}并不会{/i}主动来找我帮忙……

lines.en: {i}But what if they did?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但万一她们找了呢？{/i}

lines.en: I’m sure Makoto will understand my decision to just let her handle all of this instead of doing it on my own when it’s for the sake of her classmates.
lines.zh: 我相信 Makoto 会理解我的决定——为了她的同班同学，这些事就交给她来处理，而不是由我亲自做。

lines.en: Look, here’s one of them now.
lines.zh: 看，这不就来了一个。

lines.en: Unless...
lines.zh: 除非……

lines.en: : I’m doing them right now, Makoto. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我现在就在做，Makoto。别担心。

lines.en: : Umm...it’s actually Futaba. Is it...okay if I come in?
lines.zh: : 呃……其实是 Futaba。我……可以进来吗？

lines.en: Woah. I guess someone actually {i}does{/i} need my help today?
lines.zh: 哇哦。看来今天{i}真{/i}有人需要我帮忙？

lines.en: I suddenly feel a lot better about neglecting my responsibilities.
lines.zh: 我突然觉得，怠忽自己的职责也没那么过意不去了。

lines.en: : Sure. Just don’t tell the class representative that I’m irresponsible.
lines.zh: : 当然。只是别跟班长说我不负责任。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo2
: Irresponsible when it comes to what, exactly? I’m not...interrupting something, am I?
lines.zh: : 在哪方面不负责任，具体说说？我没……打扰到你吧？

lines.en: : Nothing that I actually wanted to do, so I wouldn’t worry too much about it.
lines.zh: : 反正也不是我真的想做的事，所以你不用担心。

lines.en: : But anyway, is something wrong? Or are you just dropping by because you miss me?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，出什么事了？还是说你只是想我了才顺路过来？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo3
: I...wouldn’t do that. You’re probably far too busy for me to drop by just because I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 我……不会那么做的。你大概忙得很，我不该只是因为想见你就跑过来。

lines.en: : I find it surprising how you can say that despite the many times I have dropped by your dorm room specifically because I did {i}not{/i} have anything to do.
lines.zh: : 我还挺惊讶你能说出这种话，毕竟我有多少次纯粹因为{i}没事{/i}干就跑去你宿舍找你。

lines.en: : It’s a little different when you’re the one who comes to me...Especially since you never intend to burden me when you do.
lines.zh: : 换成是你来找我，感觉就不太一样了……尤其是因为你来的时候，从来没打算给我添麻烦。

lines.en: : Ahh. So you intend to burden me today?
lines.zh: : 啊。那你今天是打算来给我添麻烦的？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo4
: Maybe...just a little bit.
lines.zh: : 也许……就一点点。

lines.en: : Yumi again?
lines.zh: : 又是 Yumi？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo2
: How did you know?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Because she’s the only thing that ever lands you here. What did she do this time?
lines.zh: : 因为只有她才会把你送到这儿来。这次她又做了什么？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo3
: Thankfully not much since Ayane showed up and...I guess convinced her to leave me alone for the time being.
lines.zh: : 幸好没太过分，因为 Ayane 出现了……我想是她劝住了 Yumi，让她暂时放过我。

lines.en: : But she...umm...
lines.zh: : 可是她……呃……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say she was a little more assertive than usual and...I was a little more {i}defenseless{/i} than usual as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这么说吧，她比平时更咄咄逼人了一点，而我……也比平时更{i}无力招架{/i}了一点。

lines.en: It’s nice hearing that Ayane is going out of her way for Futaba as well- but I guess I’m not that surprised to hear it since she seems like the type to step up and intervene in something like that.
lines.zh: 听说 Ayane 也在为 Futaba 挺身而出，我挺欣慰的——不过我倒也不算太意外，因为她看起来就是会站出来插手这种事的人。

lines.en: If I could be everywhere at once, I’d have no issue with becoming a sort of personal bodyguard for Futaba or...whoever else Yumi decides to fuck with on any given day.
lines.zh: 如果我能同时出现在所有地方，我倒不介意当个 Futaba 的专属保镖……或者干脆是 Yumi 哪天决定找谁麻烦时，那个人的专属保镖。

lines.en: Unfortunately, sometimes it feels like I’m barely even in {i}one{/i} place at once. So relying on other people to make up for my inability to involve myself is just...something I have to do every once in a while.
lines.zh: 可惜的是，有时候我连「同时待在{i}一个{/i}地方」都做不到。所以，靠别人来弥补我无法亲自介入这件事，只是……我偶尔不得不做的事。

lines.en: : What was it that made you more defenseless, if you don’t mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 介意我问一下吗，到底是什么让你那么无力招架？

lines.en: : Did she barge into your room or something like that?
lines.zh: : 是她闯进你房间之类的吗？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo5
: Well, no...umm...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不是……呃……

lines.en: : This actually happened in...the shower room after gym class one day...
lines.zh: : 其实事情发生在……有一天体育课后，在淋浴间里……

lines.en: Perhaps I should find a way to make myself more available after all?
lines.zh: 也许我终究该想办法让自己更「有空」一点？

lines.en: If Futaba needs someone to protect her while she is completely naked, I should be the one to step up so Ayane doesn’t have to anymore.
lines.zh: 如果 Futaba 在浑身赤裸的时候需要有人保护，那个人应该是我，这样 Ayane 就不用再出头了。

lines.en: That’s simply the right thing for me to do as her teacher.
lines.zh: 作为她的老师，那本就是我该做的正确的事。

lines.en: : Are you worried she’s going to do it again? Because if things are progressing to the point where she’s cornering you in the showers-
lines.zh: : 你担心她还会再来一次吗？因为如果事情已经发展到她会在淋浴间把你逼到角落——

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo6

: I...well, I {i}know{/i} she’s going to do it again because...she’s Yumi and I’m {i}me.{/i} And I’m not asking you to...discipline her or anything like that since...I don’t know if it’s something she can control.
lines.zh: : 我……嗯，我{i}知道{/i}她还会再犯，因为……她是 Yumi，而我是我。而且我不是要你去……惩戒她什么的，因为……我也不知道那是不是她能控制得了的。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo7
: I guess I...I’m just being selfish and...wanted to hear you console me...and tell me that she’s wrong again.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是……我有点自私，只是……想听你安慰我……想再听你说一次是她不对。

lines.en: : I feel like I’ve been doing that a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我最近越来越常这样了。

lines.en: : You have...Which is why I said I’ll be burdening you a little bit today...
lines.zh: : 你确实……所以我才说，今天要给你添一点麻烦……

lines.en: : Futaba, if repeatedly consoling you is actually going to help you here, I’ll do it. But, based on how you’re still coming to my office seeking the same thing-
lines.zh: : Futaba，如果反复安慰你真的对你有帮助，我会做。但看你现在还是为了同一件事来我办公室——

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo8
: I’m sure it sounds weird to you, but...at the same time...have you ever gone through something like this, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我知道这在你听来很奇怪，可是……话说回来……你自己经历过这种事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Where...someone you don’t have any problem with has more problems with you than you can count?
lines.zh: : 就是……一个你完全没意见的人，却对你有数都数不清的意见？

lines.en: scene colorbars
scene futabanewtwo8
: No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : See? I didn’t think so...
lines.zh: : 看吧？我就知道没有……

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo3
: You’re...naturally good looking, and...
lines.zh: : 你……天生就长得好看，而且……

lines.en: : I guess what I’m saying is that you’d think that I’d be immune to things like this for as long as I’ve put up with them, but...
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，我忍了这么久，按理说早就该对这种事免疫了，可是……

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。

lines.en: : The only thing that ever works is being reminded by someone else that the Futaba Fukuyama that Yumi sees...
lines.zh: : 唯一管用的办法，就是让别人来提醒我：Yumi 眼中的那个 Futaba Fukuyama……

lines.en: : That the Futaba Fukuyama that {i}I{/i} see is the one that’s actually twisted.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}眼中看到的那个 Futaba Fukuyama，才是真正扭曲的那个。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo8
: So, I’m sorry again for the inconvenience as I really don’t want to trouble you...but today was one of those days where I just wanted to be reassured.
lines.zh: : 所以，再次为给你添麻烦道歉，我真的不想打扰你……但今天就是那种只想要有人来让我安心的日子。

lines.en: : ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ...Sensei？

lines.en: : Sorry, yeah. I’ll reassure you whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，嗯。你想让我安心，我随时都在。

lines.en: : I just wish there was something more I could do.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望自己还能多做点什么。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo9
: Don’t. You’re already doing a great job, Sensei. It’s {i}me{/i} who needs to figure out something else to do.
lines.zh: : 别这样。你已经做得很好了，Sensei。需要想别的办法的人{i}是我{/i}。

lines.en: : Positive reinforcement can only carry a person so far...
lines.zh: : 正面的鼓励能撑着一个人走的路，也就那么远……

lines.en: : Did you know I actually used to be pretty skinny? It was a really long time ago...before I even met Rin...but there was a time where people would say things like, “You need some more meat on your bones.”
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我以前其实挺瘦的。那是很久以前了……在我遇到 Rin 之前……那时候还有人会对我说「你身上得多长点肉才行」之类的话。

lines.en: : Things like that. Things that I’m sure tons of the girls in our class hear even today.
lines.zh: : 就是那种话。我敢肯定，我们班上很多女生到今天还会听到那种话。

lines.en: : But...the craziest part was that even back then, I didn’t believe them. Not one bit.
lines.zh: : 可是……最疯狂的是，即使在那个时候，我也不相信他们。一点都不信。

lines.en: : In fact, I still have trouble believing them. And if it weren’t for me being able to look back at those pictures...and see with my own eyes how badly things have changed...
lines.zh: : 事实上，到现在我还是很难相信。如果不是我还能回头去看那些照片……亲眼看到情况已经改变得多么严重……

lines.en: : I think I’d still probably say that I’ve been this way forever.
lines.zh: : 我想我大概还是会说，自己一直都是这样的。

lines.en: Futaba’s eyes lock on mine but don’t do any amount of justice in showcasing the pain she feels inside.
lines.zh: Futaba 的目光锁在我身上，却完全没能展现出她内心的痛苦。

lines.en: I want to relate- I do. But without even being able to remember anything more than a few months back, how could I possibly do that?
lines.zh: 我想感同身受——我真的想。可我连几个月前的事都记不起来，又怎么可能做到？

lines.en: Is positive reinforcement seriously the only thing I can do for her? Because, as it stands, my words are nothing more than bandages over bullet holes.
lines.zh: 正面的鼓励真的就是我唯一能为她做的事吗？因为照目前的情况来看，我的话不过是在弹孔上贴创可贴。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what to say here, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道该说什么，Futaba。

lines.en: : I wasn’t looking for a response this time...I just wanted to share a little more about myself.
lines.zh: : 这次我并不是在等你的回应……我只是想多说一点关于我自己的事。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo10
: Us writers call that {i}character development.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们这些写作者管这叫{i}角色成长{/i}。

lines.en: : Look at you, calling yourself a writer before even finishing the story I assigned you. That’s the kind of confidence I want to see more of.
lines.zh: : 看看你，我布置的故事都还没写完，就自称作家了。我就是想多看到这种自信。

lines.en: : Heheh! This confidence was a gift from you, Sensei. Without your help, I wouldn’t even be strong enough to say that yet.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！这份自信是你送给我的礼物，Sensei。没有你的帮助，我还没坚强到能说出这种话。

lines.en: : Well, here’s hoping you wind up getting strong enough to look at yourself differently in other areas as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那就希望你能变得足够坚强，在其他方面也能用不一样的眼光看待自己。

lines.en: : Do you really not want me to do anything about Yumi, though? Because as much knight-potential as Ayane has, I still think that role is better suited for someone like me.
lines.zh: : 不过你真的不要我对 Yumi 做点什么吗？因为 Ayane 再怎么有骑士潜质，我还是觉得那个角色更适合由我来当。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo9
: If I become {i}completely{/i} dependent on you, I’ll never get anywhere in life...
lines.zh: : 如果我变得{i}完全{/i}依赖你，我这一辈子都不会有出息……

lines.en: : Besides, I like Yumi. I’ve watched her stick up for Chika before when girls from another class were saying mean things about her. There’s definitely a heart in there.
lines.zh: : 再说，我喜欢 Yumi。我见过她为 Chika 出头，那时候别班的女生在说 Chika 的坏话。她心里绝对是有善意的。

lines.en: : And who knows? Maybe her being mean to me is just...her equivalent of me coming to you for encouragement and motivation?
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢？也许她对我刻薄，就相当于……我来找你寻求鼓励和动力的那种方式？

lines.en: : That’s certainly one way to look at it. Though, it’s not one I’m really sure I agree with.
lines.zh: : 这确实是一种看法。虽然我不太确定自己同不同意。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo10
: Maybe you could give Yumi some encouragement as well then? If she ever finds herself in your office without being forced in, of course.
lines.zh: : 那也许你也可以给 Yumi 一点鼓励？当然，得是她哪天不是被人押着、而是自己走进你办公室的时候。

lines.en: : Yeah, I have a good feeling that would somehow make things with Yumi and me even worse. So I’ll just keep complimenting you instead and we’ll see where that takes us.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我有种强烈的预感，那样只会让我和 Yumi 之间的关系变得更糟。所以我就继续夸你好了，看会走到哪一步。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo9
: Thank you, Sensei. And I’m sorry again for taking up so much of your time for something so...unimportant.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。也很抱歉，为了这么……不重要的事占用了你这么多时间。

lines.en: : Do you...umm...
scene futabanewtwo3
: Do you have any plans after this? Or would you maybe want to...walk home together?
lines.zh: : 你之后有什么安排吗？还是说……要不要……一起走回家？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo11
: A-And by “home,” I obviously mean the dorm! I wasn’t asking to come back to your house if...if that’s how it sounded!
lines.zh: : 而、而且我说的「家」当然是宿舍！我不是说要去你家，如果……如果听起来像那个意思的话！

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I wouldn’t mind bringing you over to my place as long as we can figure out a cover story to give Ami.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？只要能编出一个给 Ami 听的说法，我倒不介意带你回我家。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo12
: What would we...do at your house, exactly?...
lines.zh: : 我们去你家……到底要做什么？……

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo11
: F-Forget I asked! That sounded...extremely inappropriate! Please just...walk me back to the dorm!
lines.zh: : 就……当我没问！那听起来……太不得体了！请你……直接陪我走回宿舍就好！

lines.en: : If that’s okay, I mean! I completely understand if something like that is-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果可以的话！如果那样的事让你为难，我完全理解——

lines.en: : I’ll walk you back, don’t worry. It’s about time for me to leave anyway.
lines.zh: : 我会陪你走回去，别担心。反正我也该走了。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo2
: It is?...Did I really take up that much of your time?
lines.zh: : 是吗？……我真的占用了你那么多时间？

lines.en: : Yes. But, in doing so, you not only prevented me from filling out some paperwork I definitely didn’t want to touch, but allowed me to use my office for its actual purpose.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过这样一来，你不仅让我躲开了那堆我打死都不想碰的表格，还让我的办公室派上了它真正的用场。

lines.en: : That doesn’t happen very often around here.
lines.zh: : 这种事在这儿可不常有。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo9
: Well...
: I guess we both got something out of today then...
lines.zh: : 那看来今天我们都各有收获……

lines.en: scene black
scene futabanewtwo13
Futaba and I exit my office together and begin to make our way to the lockers so she can switch shoes and gather her things.
lines.zh: 我和 Futaba 一起走出办公室，朝鞋柜走去，好让她换鞋、收拾东西。

lines.en: There’s still a fair amount of girls in the school, likely on their way to club meetings or friendly gatherings, but it’s not like being seen with a student while still on school grounds is going to make {i}me {/i} look bad.
lines.zh: 学校里还有不少女生，大概正赶去社团活动或者朋友聚会，但在校园里和学生走在一起，也不至于让{i}我{/i}形象受损。

lines.en: In fact, as long as I don’t run into anyone from class who accuses me of favoritism for spending time with Futaba instead of them, I think today may actually end pretty smoothly.
lines.zh: 事实上，只要别碰上哪个同班同学指责我偏心、说我光顾着陪 Futaba 而不陪她们，我觉得今天大概能顺利收场。

lines.en: : Futaba, I am sorry in advance.
lines.zh: : Futaba，我先道个歉。

lines.en: : Hm? Sorry for what?
lines.zh: : 嗯？为什么道歉？

lines.en: : I believe I may have just jinxed us in one of my inner monologues.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我刚才在某段内心独白里，可能把我们给诅咒了。

lines.en: : As sad as it is for me to admit this...life isn’t a book, Sensei. You can’t just foreshadow events in real life by just thinking things and-
lines.zh: : 虽然说出来挺让人沮丧的……生活不是小说，Sensei。现实里你不可能光靠想点什么就来埋伏笔——

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo14
: What the heck is this?! Sensei and Futaba hangin’ out after school?! Without invitin’ me along?!
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么情况？！Sensei 和 Futaba 放学后一起鬼混？！还不叫上我？！

lines.en: : I demand an explanation right now!
lines.zh: : 我现在就要一个解释！

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo15
: Just kiddin’. I’ve got soccer practice with the gang, so I wouldn’t be able to hang out with you guys anyway.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的啦。我待会儿要跟大伙儿练足球，反正也没法跟你们一起玩。

lines.en: : Hey, you two. Why haven’t you gone home yet?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们两个。怎么还没回家？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo16
: Are you not payin’ attention to me at all?! I just told ya I have soccer practice!
lines.zh: : 你到底有没有在听我说话啊？！我刚说了我要练足球！

lines.en: : Stop focusin’ on Futaba’s melons and listen to me! Small girls need love too! Ain’t that right, Sana?!
lines.zh: : 别光盯着 Futaba 的蜜瓜看了，听我说话！小个子的女生也需要爱啊！对吧，Sana？！

lines.en: : I...don’t want to be involved in...that kind of conversation...
lines.zh: : 我……不想被卷进……那种对话里……

lines.en: : Why haven’t {i}you{/i} gone home, Sana? I already know Miku has a meeting for the home economics club or whatever it is she’s in.
lines.zh: : Sana，{i}你{/i}怎么还没回家？我已经知道 Miku 有家政社还是什么社的例会要开。

lines.en: : I am wearin’ my friggin’ uniform! You know darn well what club I’m in, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我他妈的穿着队服呢！你明明知道我在哪个社，Sensei！

lines.en: : I’m just...waiting for Ayane to finish cleaning the classroom.
lines.zh: : 我只是在……等 Ayane 打扫完教室。

lines.en: : What...um...what are...you two doing together?
lines.zh: : 什么……呃……你们两个……在一起做什么？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo17
: I was just...bothering Sensei in his office with some...personal problems.
lines.zh: : 我只是……在办公室里拿一些……私人问题麻烦 Sensei。

lines.en: : Personal problems? You doin’ okay, Futaba? Wanna rest your head on my shoulder without the fear of whatever the cops would do to Sensei if they saw you doin’ that to him?
lines.zh: : 私人问题？你还好吗，Futaba？要不要把头靠我肩膀上——当然，别担心警察看到你对他这么做会把 Sensei 怎么样。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Oh, no. I’m fine now. It was...really stupid anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦，不，我现在没事了。反正那事……也挺蠢的。

lines.en: : Well, stupid or not, I-
lines.zh: : 嗯，蠢不蠢的，我——

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo18
: HEY! WHAT’S THE BIG IDEA?! WHY ARE YOU STILL IN SCHOOL WITH GIRLS WHO AREN’T ME?!
lines.zh: : 喂！你什么意思？！你为什么还待在学校里，而且身边还是除了我以外的女生？！

lines.en: : Hah...uhh...maybe...tone it down a bit before ya just sneak up behind people and start yellin’ stuff, Ami?
lines.zh: : 哈……呃……要不要先……稍微收敛一下，别悄无声息地绕到别人背后就开始吼，Ami？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo19
: Was this {i}your{/i} idea, Miku? Are you trying to steal my uncle from me now too?
lines.zh: : 这是{i}你的{/i}主意吗，Miku？你现在也想把我舅舅从我身边抢走？

lines.en: : Huh? I was just talkin’ to Sana before soccer practice. Futaba’s the one you’ve gotta be worried about when it comes to stealin’ Sensei away.
lines.zh: : 啊？我练球前只是在跟 Sana 聊天。要说抢走 Sensei，你该担心的明明是 Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo20
: Traitor! How dare you skip our club meeting to start an affair!
lines.zh: : 叛徒！你竟敢翘掉我们的社团例会去搞外遇！

lines.en: : What?! This isn’t like that at all!
lines.zh: : 什么？！根本不是那么回事！

lines.en: : She literally told us she was going to Sensei’s office before the meeting started.
lines.zh: : 例会开始之前，她可是亲口跟我们说要去 Sensei 办公室的。

lines.en: : Does this look like an office to you, Maya?! Because it sure as heck doesn’t look like an office to me!
lines.zh: : 这在你眼里像办公室吗，Maya？！因为在我眼里它可一点都不像办公室！

lines.en: : That’s...I just...needed some help from Sensei about...some personal matters...
lines.zh: : 那是……我只是……需要 Sensei 帮我解决一些……私人问题……

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo21
: Personal matters? Is it anything we can help with?
lines.zh: : 私人问题？有什么我们能帮上忙的吗？

lines.en: : Well, you sure got over that quickly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你倒是恢复得挺快。

lines.en: : No, it’s...
lines.zh: : 不，那是……

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo22
: Um...I’m not really sure how to word it without...making it seem like I’m taking it out on {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……我不太确定该怎么说，才不会……听起来像是在拿{i}你{/i}出气。

lines.en: : On me? Did I do something wrong? Cause if this is about the yelling thing, that was pure instinct and I can’t really help it and I am sorry.
lines.zh: : 拿我出气？我做错什么了吗？如果是因为刚才吼人那件事，那纯粹是本能反应，我实在控制不了，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : No, no. Not {i}just{/i} you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 不，不是。不{i}只{/i}是你，Ami。

lines.en: : Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo23
: {i}All{/i} of you...
lines.zh: : 是你们{i}所有人{/i}……

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo24
scene futabanewtwo23
scene futabanewtwo24
scene futabanewtwo23
scene futabanewtwo24
scene futabanewtwo23
scene futabanewtwo25
: I’m sorry! I actually forgot I had...something else to do today.
lines.zh: : 对不起！我其实忘了今天还有……别的事要做。

lines.en: : Thank you for your help, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的帮忙，Sensei。

lines.en: : And...I’m sorry to everyone else for having to leave so soon.
lines.zh: : 还有……很抱歉要这么早就走，辜负了大家的好意。

lines.en: : Thank you...for your concern.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……你们的关心。

lines.en: scene futabanewtwo24
scene futabanewtwo26
scene black
Autumn came, and the leaves in the forest turned to orange and gold.
lines.zh: 秋天来了，森林里的树叶变成了橙色与金黄。

lines.en: Then, as winter approached, the wind caught them as they fell.
lines.zh: 而后，随着冬天临近，风接住了它们飘落的身影。

lines.en: It is only with the heart that one can see clearly, for the most essential things are invisible to the eye.
lines.zh: 只有用心才能看得清，真正重要的东西，用眼睛是看不见的。

lines.en: The scent of chlorine and porcelain has never smelled as beautiful as it does now.
lines.zh: 氯气与瓷砖的气味，从来没有像此刻这般美妙。

lines.en: The end.
lines.zh: 全文完。
